from __future__ import annotations
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))

stage="startup"
try:
    stage="hydrate_gate"
    from control.model_execution.patch_e106_gate import hydrate, patch_gate
    hydrate(ROOT)
    patch_gate(ROOT)

    stage="patch_route"
    p=ROOT/"control/jobs/full_a2z_governed_v4.py"
    text=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    old='ROUTE = "SESSION-ROUTE-756bff225d5a976edf6da02b"'
    new='ROUTE = "SESSION-ROUTE-DIRECTSOL-20261007-K7A1"'
    if old in text:
        p.write_text(text.replace(old,new,1),encoding="utf-8")
    elif new not in text:
        raise RuntimeError("A2Z_ROUTE_PATTERN_MISSING")

    stage="selection_file"
    sel=ROOT/"control/dev_checks/a2z_previous_selection.json"
    if not sel.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("PREVIOUS_SELECTION_MISSING")
    selection=json.loads(sel.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    stage="selection_shape"
    for key in ("originating_task_id","finding","next_action","source_hashes"):
        if key not in selection:
            raise RuntimeError("SELECTION_FIELD_MISSING:"+key)

    stage="request_result_files"
    task="A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
    req=ROOT/"control/model_execution/direct_requests"/(task+".json")
    res=ROOT/"control/model_execution/direct_results"/(task+".json")
    if not req.is_file() or not res.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("DIRECT_SOL_RECORD_MISSING")

    stage="proposal_parse"
    result=json.loads(res.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    proposal=json.loads(result["final"])
    if proposal.get("proposal_version")!=4:
        raise RuntimeError("PROPOSAL_VERSION")

    stage="a2z_import"
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/"control/codex_supervisor"))
    import experiment_gate as gate
    import model_quality_gate as q

    stage="candidate"
    candidate=ROOT/"knowledge/candidates/AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d.json"
    if not candidate.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("CANDIDATE_MISSING")

    print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_BUNDLE_DIAG")
    print("ERROR="+json.dumps({
      "stage":"PASS",
      "selection_task":selection.get("originating_task_id"),
      "proposal_version":proposal.get("proposal_version"),
      "route":"SESSION-ROUTE-DIRECTSOL-20261007-K7A1"
    },separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(1)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except BaseException as exc:
    print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_BUNDLE_DIAG")
    print("ERROR="+json.dumps({
      "stage":stage,
      "error":type(exc).__name__,
      "detail":str(exc)[:260]
    },separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(1)
